neighbours.label: a requirement stated as minimal: 'need not', 'requires only', 'need have no' (promotes ' only' and ' no')
fire: With our team on your side you need not worry about the paperwork.
A home kit that requires only a few drops of saliva arrived today.
Thanks to this new router, you need not call an engineer ever again.
We use a method which requires only tiny amounts of the sample.
With a good lawyer you need have no fear of the hearing next week.
Modern ovens clean themselves, so you need not scrub them by hand.
The patch is a simple fix which requires only a restart of the laptop.
With solar panels installed, you need not pay a large power bill.
quiet: With our team on your side you must fill in the paperwork yourself.
A home kit that requires a trip to the clinic arrived today.
Thanks to this new router, you need to call an engineer to set it up.
We use a method which requires a large supply of the sample.
With a good lawyer you should prepare well for the hearing next week.
Modern ovens are large, so you need to measure your kitchen first.
The patch is a major change which requires a full rebuild of the laptop.
With solar panels installed, you still have to pay a small power bill.

notes: Card: ' need' x3, ' requires' x3, ' needs' x3; the - pole promotes ' only', ' neither', ' merely', ' never', ' nothing'. Probe: 'you need not wait' 0.217; 'requires only a small drop' 0.185; 'needs no preparation' 0.113; 'needs little introduction' 0.045; 'requires a large machine' 0.025; 'You need a passport' 0.022. Weak, and it reads before the token that makes it minimal.
